RootMC admin — #ops-feed *Reserved for future bot traffic* — server logs, hourly snapshots, automated reports, cron output.

Nothing is wired here yet (Discord still owns automations). When we migrate, posts land here first; human summaries go to `#work-log`.

Do not use for casual chat. *Sent using* Cursor

*Current function (2026-07-30)* — _nothing wired yet_

*Planned traffic when migrated from Discord:*
• Server log uploads (`#logs` equivalent)
• Hourly snapshots / automated reports
• Cron output (economy briefs, daily summaries for staff)
• Plugin heartbeat failures
• API/worker error pings
*Today:* all of the above still posts to Discord (`#logs`, `#automated-reports`, `#hourly-snapshots`, `#tasks`, bot-spam). Do not duplicate manually here until we wire bots.

Human-readable summaries still go to `#work-log`. *Sent using* Cursor

*Discord relay setup (Slack Workflow)*

When `#ops-feed` gets a Shockbyte RSS post, fan out to Discord:

1. *Workflow Builder* → Create workflow
2. *Trigger:* _New message posted to a channel_ → `#ops-feed`
3. *Optional filter:* posted by _RSS_ app only (avoids manual chat triggering Discord)
4. *Step A — Webhook POST* → `#admins` Discord incoming webhook
5. *Step B — Webhook POST* → `#updates` Discord incoming webhook
*Body (both steps, JSON):*
```{
  "content": "**Shockbyte**\n{{Message text}}\n{{Permalink}}"
}```
*Notes:* Discord max 2000 chars; RSS posts are short. Do not chat manually in this channel unless you want Discord spam. Webhook URLs live in admin password manager only — not in git. *Sent using* Cursor
